t: We’re making an app that will be coming out on the App Store in probably August of this year, and it's going to change the game. If you've been following me for a while, you know that I got my start by going through the grocery store and trying to figure out and make a record of who owns all the products on the shelves. What I discovered was that we all kind of already know this, but we mostly just have the illusion of choice, not actual choice. The vast majority of the products on the shelf in the grocery store are actually brands that are all owned by just a small handful of mega-corporations that are all majority owned by the world's biggest financial institutions, most notably BlackRock. But Buy'r is an app that lets you scan products in the grocery store, and it will tell you not only everything that's in the product and help you filter for ingredients that you don't want and stuff like that, but it also tells you who is selling that product and who owns them. With Buy'r, finally, you can make informed purchasing decisions and vote with your dollars in an informed way. We aren't going to tell you how you should be spending your money or what you should or shouldn't be eating. You're an adult, and you're perfectly capable of making those decisions for yourself. We just want you to have all of the information. So, if you want to know where your money is really going and who you're really buying from, go to buyrapp.com and sign up for the beta test today to get free beta testing access to the Buy'r app. Or, if you just want the real thing, putting your name on that same list will also ensure that you're the first to know when it hits the App Store.
